name: Coca-Cola UNITED - College Park Production Plant, GA

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (33.623174,-84.482599) and roster address (3151 Sullivan Rd) landed on a vacant paved lot ~1.5 km west of the real site - wrong location. The Census/Nominatim geocoders for the correct address (2355 Sullivan Rd) also interpolated onto a rural stretch. The actual Coca-Cola UNITED College Park Production Plant is at ~33.6268,-84.4680, off Sullivan Road in the Cooks Crossing industrial area near the I-85/I-285 interchange. Confirmed via an OSM 'Coca-Cola' POI and Street View: the building carries a red 'Coca-Cola' logo and the yard entrance has red 'TRUCK ENTRANCE' signs. It is a production + distribution facility, 325+ associates, acquired by Coca-Cola UNITED in April 2017 from The Coca-Cola Company.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Positive. Street View shows red 'TRUCK ENTRANCE' signs at a driveway off Sullivan Road and a chain-link perimeter fence. The property is fenced with a controlled truck entrance. Gate barrier hardware not clearly resolved in the available views; truckGate=true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No distinct freestanding beside-the-lane guard booth identified at the truck entrance in Street View or z20 satellite. guardShack=false at medium confidence.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Truck gate present, no guard shack identified -> remoteGs=true (kiosk/badge check-in implied). Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~45 dock doors along the production building's long west face with trailers backed in - band 25-50, approximate count from z19 imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ trailers parked without tractors in the large west drop yard - dense rows of staged trailers, a major drop-yard operation.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs through the property between the production building and the west trailer yard, directly alongside the building's east/dock side - the site is rail-served. railServed=true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks read as one continuous bank along the building's west face; no clearly separate ship/receive cluster. shipRcvSeparate=false.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated trailer-storage drop yard on the west half of the property, separate from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved holding area inside the gate before the docks/drop yard.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main production/distribution building plus an attached office building = 2.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the Atlanta metro near Hartsfield-Jackson airport and the I-85/I-285 interchange, dense industrial fabric - Urban.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach from the Sullivan Road gate to the docks holds 3+ trucks.
